governanceNotes: D1 batch 35 (2026-09-23): deferred. Negative screen recorded 2026-09-23: (i) direction is inverted for outcome purposes - the literature documents primary conditions producing Fregoli episodes rather than Fregoli producing downstream outcomes: the review of psychiatric disorders associated with acquired brain pathology (PMID 30183352) places Fregoli and other delusional misidentification syndromes among psychotic manifestations of right-hemisphere or bilateral lesion pathology, the report of delusional misidentification syndromes in obsessive-compulsive disorder (PMID 22922811) documents Capgras and Fregoli syndromes arising within severe treatment-resistant OCD with paranoid personality disorder or pervasive developmental disorder, the delusional-misidentification review (PMID 29754115) situates Fregoli as a subtype of the misidentification spectrum classically described within primary psychiatric illness, and the scoping review of delusional misidentification syndromes following acquired brain injury (PMID 42436607; 34 studies almost all single-case with one observational cohort, Capgras-dominant) confirms the manifestation framing; (ii) zero-record outcome screening - the targeted 'Fregoli syndrome outcome' query returns only the PMID 42436607 scoping review itself and 'Fregoli syndrome treatment recovery' returns zero records, with no Fregoli-specific depression, anxiety, or functional-outcome quantification in any hit because delusional-misidentification-wide series do not isolate the Fregoli subtype; (iii) nosology - Fregoli is a delusional misidentification subtype presenting within primary psychiatric, neurodegenerative, or brain-injury conditions, and mirroring the capgras-syndrome and cotard-s-syndrome depressive-disorder edges would import evidence bases specific to those identities while the Fregoli-specific literature located here documents only reverse-direction and case-level occurrence within primary illness, failing the reverse-arrow guard the batch-33 female-infertility counter-evidence pattern and the euthyroid-sick-syndrome deferral both enforce. Reopening condition: a directional cohort of Fregoli patients with a catalog-fit outcome, or Fregoli-specific comorbidity quantification with chronology.
